decision.reason: Mathlib’s quotient-map and liftQ declarations prove the exact reviewed endpoint; independently compiled and axiom-audited in NotesProofs/ReviewedModuleQuotientConnection.lean, evidence/reviewed-module-quotient-build.log.
decision.proof:
by
  intro R _ M _ _ U
  refine ⟨fun m n => (map_add U.mkQ m n).symm,
    fun r m => (U.mkQ.map_smul r m).symm, U.mkQ_surjective, ?_⟩
  intro N _ _ f hf
  refine ⟨U.liftQ f hf, U.liftQ_mkQ f hf, ?_⟩
  intro g hg
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro q
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := U.mkQ_surjective q
  exact (DFunLike.congr_fun hg m).trans (DFunLike.congr_fun (U.liftQ_mkQ f hf) m).symm
